title: Q-SETUN: Brusentsov Ternary Qutrit Core with Cellular Apoptosis for Edge AI
description: Zero-FLOP Neuromorphic Edge AI using Brusentsov balanced ternary qutrits and cellular apoptosis. Physical silicon benchmark on ESP32 demonstrates 1.0 microsecond latency, zero heap allocation (malloc=0), and 270x speedup over TensorFlow Lite Micro.
